title.narrative: Pacific Australia Labour Mobility (PALM) scheme - additional funding

description.narrative: Temporary funding supported the expansion of the Pacific Australia Labour Mobility (PALM) scheme. The expansion included increased funding to the Pacific Labour Facility (PLF) to manage PALM scheme. As part of machinery of government changes on 1 July 2022, this funding and contract moved to DEWR while DFAT continued to received services. Up to 30 June 2023, funding supported the Pacific Labour Facility (PLF), under the direction of DFAT and in collaboration with DEWR who managed comonents of domestic deliver of the Pacific Australia Labour Mobility (PALM) scheme. As part of machinery of government changes on 1 July 2022, this funding and contract moved to DEWR while DFAT continued to received services. From 1 July 2023, domestic delivery components of the PALM sceme delivered by the PLF was funded soley from DEWR departmental funding (not ODA). The PLF ceased domestic delivery 31 December 2023. The funding contributed to the following goals: • An increase of appropriately skilled and diverse women and men are mobilised to work in Australia. • There is a sustainable and growing demand for Pacific women and men workers from Australian industry. • The PALM scheme maximises benefit and minimises risk to Pacific women and men workers and Pacific and Australian communities.
